text: Ladies and gentlemen! In this corner, the boss of the whole building, the Landlord! They brought their own face, built from their own photos, and bolted it onto a bare Mixamo X Bot mannequin. Nothing changed this round, so the realism score stays at 33, same as last time. The judge calls it valid and honest, but says it needs a body, skin, clothing and real hair. Standing one point eight two meters, a pressure fighter who walks you down and throws you when you turtle. Please welcome, THE OWNER!
